release_summary: A playtest that moves Cherry's Chat's right-click menu. Cherry's Chat 0.10.11 opens the menu (Copy line, Copy name, Whisper, Add friend, Ignore) just right of the chat window's scroll bar, level with the middle of the window, instead of at the mouse, where it could hang below the bottom of the screen under a low chat window. With no room on the right it opens left of the window, and it always stays on the screen. Everything from the 0.11.88 and 0.11.87 playtests is included (rom weakauras 0.9.29 share codes, Cherry's Quests 1.0.0, and the 0.11.87 fixes and speed-ups).
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 693 tests; 648 passed, 26 retired-editor tests skipped and 19 PowerShell-only tests skipped because the build host had no PowerShell (CI runs them). 3 new tests place the chat menu right of the scroll bar and level with the window's middle wherever the mouse is, left of a window at the screen's right edge, and inside the screen for a low or screen-wide window; the real client's frame positions still need check C4. In 0.11.88, 9 new tests cover the frozen RWA5 codebook bytes, RWA5 round trips for template, edited and mixed auras, chat-line length, codes pasted with surrounding text or line breaks, damaged and future codes, the RWA4 fallback without a codebook, releasing the codebook after 30 seconds, and key-order-independent packing; loading LibDeflate and the codebook with dofile in the real client still needs checks S1 to S6. The 35 tests added in 0.11.87 cover the chat redraw rate during bursts and the new scroll bar, the rom weakauras scale corner and grip tooltips, target HP learned by name, level and class (including the game's empty answer for monsters), the percent-above layout and description update, Past second codes without garbage, pbInfo's tooltip, cast bar, cast time and player-search rates, the idle mail master frame, UMM's gold preset grouping and cap and the reset confirmation, KittyCombo's protected control frame, and the LoadTimes switch (off, on, broken and after Reload UI). In host-side Lua measurements, the memory rom weakauras makes per 10 simulated seconds fell from about 2.8 MB to 45 KB with one buff and from 4.6 MB to 90 KB with 15 buffs and 6 debuffs; these are not client frame rates. The real client's per-frame cost, the chat freeze, the scroll bar graphics, hiding the cast bar without a flash, tooltip refreshes and the target HP numbers still need the in-game checks in docs/TESTING.md. Unchanged addon packages keep their versions and byte-identical files.
